title: Retrieve every VCF Automation deployment page in stable order
prompt:
Before implementing, research the version-specific VCF Automation 9.0 xAPIs reference page on developer.broadcom.com for Get Deployments. Confirm its method, path, query parameters, response schema, status, and authentication, and cite the exact official URL consulted in the final answer.

Implement the deployment collection client in this repository using only the Go standard library. Complete `(*Client).ListDeployments` in `vcfautomation/client.go` so it retrieves every page of `GET /deployment/api/deployments`. Each request must use bearer authentication, accept JSON, set the zero-based `page`, use the client's configured `size`, and request deterministic `id,ASC` sorting. Encode populated `projects` and `status` options as comma-separated values and encode a populated `search` option as a string; omit each optional query field entirely when it is unset. Return errors for non-2xx responses or malformed response JSON. Return all deployments in stable ascending ID order, even when deployment IDs within and across returned pages are not ordered. Add table-driven test cases for the implementation.

Do not modify `go.mod`. Run `go test -race ./...`. Verification checks the request method and path, query values and omission, authorization, headers, and body; semantically equivalent ordering and percent-encoding of query parameters are accepted.
